rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for intense physical or emotional suffering.

example.english: Being this sick lately has put me in misery.
example.traditional: 呢排病到咁，我真係好痛苦。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 beng6 dou3 gam3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tung3 fu2

rows.note: Use this for a misfortune or unfortunate event that causes misery.

example.english: This fire left the whole family in misery.
example.traditional: 今次火災令成家人都好不幸。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 fo2 zoi1 ling6 seng4 gaa1 jan4 dou1 hou2 bat1 hang6

rows.note: Use this when the cause of misery is a serious calamity or disaster rather than ordinary bad luck.

example.english: This earthquake brought misery to many people; it was a real disaster.
example.traditional: 呢場地震令好多人受苦，真係一場災難。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 dei6 zan3 ling6 hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 fu2 zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 zoi1 naan6
